definitions.explanation: A child who attends 幼稚園 (kindergarten), typically aged 3–5 in Japan. Kindergartens are under the Ministry of Education and focus on early childhood education.

examples.japanese: {幼稚園児|ようちえんじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいる→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: Kindergarteners are playing in the park.

examples.japanese: {幼稚園児|ようちえんじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{読|よ}める→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦{絵本|えほん}→絵本：10429_ehon⟧。
examples.english: A picture book that even a kindergartener can read.

examples.japanese: ⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{幼稚園児|ようちえんじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{入園|にゅうえん}→入園：20847_nyuuen⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: My son will start kindergarten next year, so we've begun preparing for enrollment.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{幼稚園|ようちえん}→幼稚園：04703_youchien⟧ (kindergarten) + {児|じ} (child). In Japan, ⟦{幼稚園|ようちえん}→幼稚園：04703_youchien⟧ is managed by the Ministry of Education ({文部科学省|もんぶかがくしょう}) and focuses on educational development, unlike ⟦{保育園|ほいくえん}→保育園：04704_hoikuen⟧ (daycare/nursery), which is under the Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare.

JAPANESE SCHOOL-AGE TERMS:
- {幼稚園児|ようちえんじ}: kindergartener (ages 3–5)
- ⟦{保育園児|ほいくえんじ}→保育園児：23943_hoikuenji⟧: daycare child (ages 0–5)
- ⟦{小学生|しょうがくせい}→小学生：03069_shougakusei⟧: elementary school student (ages 6–12)
- ⟦{中学生|ちゅうがくせい}→中学生：10973_chuugakusei⟧: junior high school student (ages 12–15)
- ⟦{高校生|こうこうせい}→高校生：01580_koukousei⟧: high school student (ages 15–18)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {幼稚園児|ようちえんじ}{向|む}け: aimed at kindergarteners
- {幼稚園児|ようちえんじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{保護者|ほごしゃ}→保護者：11564_hogosha⟧: parents of kindergarteners
- {幼稚園児|ようちえんじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧わかる: even a kindergartener can understand

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{保育園児|ほいくえんじ}→保育園児：23943_hoikuenji⟧: daycare child — attends ⟦{保育園|ほいくえん}→保育園：04704_hoikuen⟧, which emphasizes childcare over education and accepts younger children
- ⟦{園児|えんじ}→園児：18157_enji⟧: kindergartener/nursery child — shorter form that can refer to children at either ⟦{幼稚園|ようちえん}→幼稚園：04703_youchien⟧ or ⟦{保育園|ほいくえん}→保育園：04704_hoikuen⟧
